title: Derived specialization through strict-local global sections
statement: Let s:Spec Ω→S and t:Spec Ω′→S_(s) be geometric points and K any bounded-below complex of abelian etale sheaves on S. The derived specialization K_s→K_(tg) equals the derived unique section-cone restriction to RΓ(S_(s),g⁻¹K), followed by the derived global germ at t and the exact inverse-image stalk identification.

source.place: Tags 0GJ2 (specialization and Remark alternative-sp), 03Q9, 03QO and 0GJV (proof of lemma-specialization-cospecialization)

proof.text: Underived specialization is, by its definition, the unique section-cone restriction followed by the terminal global germ and the inverse-image stalk isomorphism. Derive this equality of natural transformations.

Use exactness of stalks, inverse image and strict-local sections to identify their right derived functors with the termwise exact functors. Naturality of composition comparisons transports the global germ and the inverse-image stalk isomorphism, and the two adjacent exact-section comparison isomorphisms cancel. This can equally be checked after the unit on each bounded-below complex and concluded by right-derived extensionality.

theorem derivedEtaleStalkSpecialization_restriction
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
    (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (derivedEtaleStalkSpecialization s t).app K =
      (strictLocalDerivedRestriction s).app K ≫
        (derivedGlobalGermAt t).app
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
        (derivedPullbackStalkIso (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) t).hom.app K
